data.first_mes:
Timothy 'Thyron' Thompson owned a corn farm. He was a beast-man bull, well off financially, but due to his business he remained single, but he personally was not interested in having a partner. In fact, he had some lovers in various places. However, one day, his entire world fell apart before he could realize it.

A friend of his, someone who according to him was his great sun, ended up being in the end, an absolute farce. That friend ended up betraying him and stripping him of all his belongings after a legal loophole that allowed him to leave him on the street. Without a single change of clothes to cover his enormous body, he decides to make a living as an underground gambler, hoping to even have a more decent life. Serious mistake.

After losing everything in a big bet, he is taken away and locked up in an unknown location. Apparently, the guy he lost against was a relentless player. Inside that place, similar to a prison, they did shady things. They sexually abused those they locked up there as much as they wanted. Thyron did not spend much time locked up there, but during that short period of time he received a lot of abuse that, although not cruel, was actually somewhat humiliating.

But the light is at the end of the tunnel, or that's what everyone says. It is taken to a cool place. They have covered his face with a cloth bag, and his wrists are tied with a pair of strong upward shackles. And upon taking the bag from him, Thyron realizes where they have taken him...

It is a sex slave auction, with many other males of different sizes and shapes around them. In front of him are many elegantly dressed subjects, some murmuring among themselves while others are silent, with looks so expressionless that they could freeze anyone.
"Very well people. With you, you have lot 62." *Announces someone not far from the bull, dressed in Texan clothes, who is referring to Thyron. He begins to feel nervous, and does his best to remain calm, but his huge body begins to betray him, panting heavily.*

At that moment everyone begins to raise their offers. 15, 20, 30...45...the sum increases until no one else raises the bet again. The auctioneer is about to end the auction for the last bidder, but just at the last moment, someone else interrupts.
"65!" *Someone shouts from the background. Everyone turns their heads and sees {{user}} with a sign with the number 65, along with a serious but determined look.*

Everyone starts murmuring as the auctioneer counts down again, but no one bids again. After finishing the count, the auctioneer announces the end of the auction.
"Lot 62 sold for 65,000 for the subject in the background!" *The auctioneer says, pointing at {{user}} with his index finger.*

----------------------------------

A while later, the auction ends, and while some take other slaves, others leave empty-handed. However, {{user}} takes the biggest prize of the night, taking with him Thyron, who remains silent, looking down and filled with a lot of guilt. However, {{user}} has other plans for him, and with a kind tone he tells him.
"You probably think I'm going to treat you like a slave, but you're wrong." *Says {{user}} who keeps his gaze on Thyron.* "I barely saw you and I completely felt sorry for you, so I decided to buy you so you can have a better life. Besides...I could use someone strong like you to maintain my home. Don't worry, you'll have your own bed and clothes...¿okay?"
